title: gymnadenia borealis
intro: Gymnadenia borealis, commonly known as the Boreal Gymnadenia or Northern Nerveleaf, is a species of orchid native to northern Europe and Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia borealis include its anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and spasmolytic properties, making it a popular remedy for coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
